ethnic_groups.name: Shenwa/Chenoui

ethnic_groups.name: Tuareg (Kel Ahaggar)
ethnic_groups.notes: Tuareg confederacy of the Hoggar Mountains in far south

natural_resources.notes: Third-largest African oil producer; gas reserves among world's top 10; Saharan hydrocarbons backbone of economy; Hassi Messaoud/Hassi R'Mel fields; Dutch disease symptoms; In Salah carbon capture project; shale gas potential (third-largest global reserves, unexploited due to water/fracking opposition)

military.notes: Largest military budget in Africa; non-interventionist doctrine; Soviet-era equipment being modernized (Russian arms primary supplier); French nuclear tests at Reggane 1960-66 (17 tests); compulsory 12-month military service; ANP (People's National Army) historically dominant political force

infrastructure.notes: East-West Highway; Algiers Metro; national broadband (Algérie Telecom); Algiers-Oran high-speed rail planned.

climate_environment.notes: Sahara expanding southward; Great Green Wall participant (limited); water scarcity acute in south; Mediterranean ecosystems under pressure.

debt_aid.sovereign_wealth_fund: Revenue Regulation Fund (depleted from $77B peak 2014 to ~$40B)
debt_aid.notes: Historically refused IMF/World Bank structural adjustment; paid off all foreign debt by 2006 using oil revenues; now re-accumulating debt as oil prices fell

education.notes: Free education through university; Arabization policy post-1962 replaced French with Arabic; significant brain drain to France; highest R&D spending in Africa after South Africa; 1.7M university students

diaspora_migration.notes: Sahrawi refugees hosted in Tindouf camps since 1975 (~170k claimed, disputed); Algerian diaspora in France dates to colonial labour migration; harkis (Algerians who fought for France) controversy
diaspora_migration.immigration_policy: Restrictive; transit country for sub-Saharan migrants

digital_economy.notes: Yassir ride-hailing unicorn; government digitization push; startup law 2022; internet censorship during protests (Hirak 2019-20); 4G coverage expanding; e-payment adoption growing slowly

country_profile.notes_unique: Largest country in Africa by area; fought an eight-year war of independence from France (1954–1962) that became a model for anti-colonial struggles worldwide.
country_profile.national_motto: By the People and for the People

geography.terrain: Mostly high plateau and desert; Atlas Mountains in the north; Sahara covers 80%+ of territory
geography.notes: Largest country in Africa by area; 80%+ Saharan desert; Tell Atlas and Saharan Atlas mountain ranges; Mediterranean coast.

economy_extended.notes: Hydrocarbon-dependent economy (95% of export revenue); Sonatrach state oil company; heavy state subsidies on fuel, housing, food; import substitution policy; strict FDI regulations (51/49 rule relaxed 2020).

health.notes: Free public healthcare; well-developed hospital network; growing NCD burden; medical tourism to France/Tunisia for specialised care.

food_agriculture.notes: Major wheat/barley importer; date palm oases in Sahara (Ghardaia, Biskra); PNDA agricultural renewal programme; dairy sector growing; limited arable land constrains self-sufficiency.

energy.notes: Africa's largest natural gas reserves; OPEC member; Sonatrach 5th-largest gas company globally; Hassi Messaoud oil field; Hassi R'Mel gas field; solar potential enormous (Sahara) but underdeveloped; Tafouk1 solar project planned.

transport.notes: East-West Highway (1,216 km, connects Morocco border to Tunisia); Trans-Saharan Highway; Algiers Metro (2011); extensive domestic air network to connect Saharan south.

tourism.notes: Underdeveloped tourism despite enormous potential; visa restrictions; limited hotel infrastructure outside cities; Saharan tourism growing; Roman ruins rival those in Tunisia.

human_rights_gender.notes: Family Code governs personal status; Amazigh cultural rights recognised (2016 constitution); Hirak protest movement 2019-21; press restrictions; women's rights progress mixed.

security_stability.notes: Relatively stable post-Civil War (1991-2002); strong security apparatus; closed border with Morocco since 1994; arms buildup (largest African military budget); AQIM largely expelled but residual threat in Sahel margins.

cultural_heritage.film_industry: Notable (Z, Battle of Algiers co-production legacy; Algerian Film Commission)
intangible_heritage_items: Annual pilgrimage to the mausoleum of Sidi Abd el-Qader Ben Mohammed
cultural_heritage.media_landscape: State-dominated (ENTV, Radio Algérienne); private newspapers; online media growing; press freedom limited
cultural_heritage.notes: Rich blend of Amazigh, Arab, Ottoman, French cultural influences; raï music originated in Oran; Algerian literature in French and Arabic; 2022 film 'The Last Queen' international recognition.

legal_system.legal_tradition: Civil law (French-influenced) with Islamic law for personal status
legal_system.customary_law_role: Limited (some Amazigh customary practices in Kabylie)
legal_system.notes: Dual French-Islamic legal heritage; 2020 constitutional referendum; Council of State (administrative); Supreme Court; Constitutional Court; state of emergency provisions used historically.

comparative_rankings._note: Country position relative to continent and global. 'rank' = 1 is best/largest.
comparative_rankings.notes: Africa's largest country by area; top 5 GDP on continent; major gas exporter.
